description.value: An event-related fMRI study examined heroin-related cue-induced brain responses in heroin-dependent patients and their relationship to subsequent relapse during a 3-month follow-up.

spans.text: The aim of our study was to assess the relationship between subjective heroin craving and brain response in heroin-dependent individuals when exposed to heroin-related cues and relapse during a 3-month follow-up period.
